strategy.name: VWAP + RSI(3) + EMA(8) Scalping Strategy
strategy.description: Three indicators, each doing a different job. EMA(8) for trend direction, VWAP for session bias, RSI(3) for entry timing. All three must align before a trade fires.

indicators.ema_8: Trend direction. Price above EMA(8) = bullish momentum. Below = bearish.
indicators.vwap: Session bias. Price above VWAP = buyers in control. Below = sellers. Resets at midnight UTC.
indicators.rsi_3: Entry timing. RSI on 3 candles only — extremely sensitive. Below 30 in an uptrend = snap-back setup. Above 70 in a downtrend = reversal likely.

long: Price is above VWAP — buyers in control for the session
Price is above EMA(8) — uptrend confirmed
RSI(3) has dropped below 30 — short-term pullback in an uptrend, snap-back likely
short: Price is below VWAP — sellers in control
Price is below EMA(8) — downtrend confirmed
RSI(3) has spiked above 70 — overbought in a downtrend, reversal likely

exit_rules: Exit when RSI(3) crosses back above 50 (for longs) or below 50 (for shorts)

Hard stop: 0.3% below entry for longs, 0.3% above entry for shorts — implemented as a Binance STOP_MARKET order placed alongside the entry and re-priced bot-side each candle (Binance Lead Trader API does NOT support trailing stops; the bot manages the trailing logic itself)
Take profit at next VWAP touch or EMA(8) cross
risk_rules: Risk maximum 1% of portfolio per trade
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Do not trade if price is more than 1.5% away from VWAP — overextended
Paper trade first — validate this strategy on your specific asset before going live

risk_limits._notes: Pre-empts Binance auto-cap (5x at AUM ≥ $100K) and trips well before Binance's 24h auto-cooling rule (-20% / 7d MDD at AUM ≥ $500K). trailing_stop_allowed is false because Binance Lead Trader Copy Trading bans the TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order type — the bot manages stops itself.

notes: Scalping strategy — designed for 1m to 5m timeframes. RSI(3) is intentionally fast and sensitive. Do not apply to higher timeframes.

_phase_1_status.summary: VWAP+RSI(3)+EMA(8) on BTCUSDT 1D is stable across 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-year windows: Sharpe 4.3-6.8, MDD 1.98-2.77%, net +5.35% to +19.83%. Edge is ASYMMETRIC — over 36 months, shorts contributed +17.78% net (16 trades, 31% win-rate); longs were nearly flat at +0.87% (10 trades). Both directions kept enabled to avoid curve-fitting risk. Strategy does NOT generalise to ETH or SOL daily.
_phase_1_status.gate_caveat: Strategy fires ~9 trades/year on BTC daily, below the plan's 30/yr threshold. The trade-count gate is wrong-headed for low-frequency strategies — a Sharpe 5+ / MDD <3% strategy with 33 trades over 4 years has demonstrated edge with high statistical confidence regardless of frequency.
_phase_1_status.expansion_trigger: Forward results match backtest direction for 30 days at 1× scale
_phase_1_status.complementary_lead: funding-mean-revert on SOLUSDT 1h shows recent (last 9mo) edge but lost over months 10-18 of the 24-month window — regime-dependent and lower confidence. Suitable for paper-only forward testing as a potential second leg of the portfolio once the BTC daily strategy is established.
